summary.result: It is suggested that the ecological and cultural resources need to be taken into account in the process of rural village planning.
summary.background: Based on the results of this study, rural villages in Korea can be divided into 4 types - (1) the village abundant in both ecological and cultural resources, (2) the village abundant in only ecological resources, (3) the village abundant in only cultural resources and (4) the village insufficient in two resources.
summary.method: And further, this study found that most ecological resources in rural villages are deteriorated or deteriorating.
